![BattleText Forever logo](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/severd8/battletextforever/main/art/logo.png)

# BattleText Forever

**Scrolling combat text for World of Warcraft: Forever.**

BattleText Forever puts the fight on your screen: your hits scroll on one side, the damage you take on the other, heals under your character, and loot and experience in the middle. It's built for Forever's addon rules, in the spirit of the classic scrolling combat text addons.

> **Bugs or ideas?** Please post them on [GitHub](https://github.com/severd8/battletextforever/issues/new/choose), where I can keep track of them.

---

## Features

- **Your hits**, tinted by school, with the spell's name and icon when the game lets BattleText tell which spell it was. Crits are bigger and hold in place for a moment, and rapid hits of one spell add up ("Swipe 135 (x3)").
- **What happens to you**, in its own area: the damage you take, and the attacks you dodge, parry, block or resist. Magic hits show in their school's color with its name ("-120 Shadow"), so you know when to use a Shadow Ward or a resistance potion.
- **Heals**, the ones you get and the ones you do, in their own Healing area under your character (or with the damage, if you prefer).
- **Notifications**: combat, experience, reputation, honor, loot, money, skill ups, a paladin's seals going on and coming off, and (if you turn it on) your buffs.
- **Ability alerts**: "Overpower!" when your target dodges you, "Revenge!" when you dodge, parry or block (in Defensive Stance), "Riposte!" and "Counterattack!" when you parry (with the talent), "Execute!" and "Hammer of Wrath!" when your target is low enough, and procs: the ones the game lights up on your action bars (like Clearcasting), and Missile Barrage, Revelation, Hot Streak, Fingers of Frost and Brain Freeze when the game lets BattleText see the buff.
- **Combo points**: "2 CP" as they build, "5 CP: Finish it!" when you have them all.
- **Cooldowns ready**: "Kick ready" when a spell of yours comes off a cooldown of 8 seconds or more.
- **Interrupts**: "Interrupted Frostbolt" when you or your pet stop an enemy's cast.
- **Dispels**: "Dispelled Deadly Poison" when you cleanse a friend or yourself, "Purged ..." when you take a buff off an enemy, "Stole ..." with Spellsteal. Tick one box in the Combat Log for it: right-click the Combat Log tab, then Settings, Message Types, Auras, **Dispels**. Without that box, BattleText shows the cure spell you cast ("Cleanse") but can't tell what it took off.
- **Fight summary**: when a fight ends, your damage, DPS and healing ("4,820 damage (127 DPS), 1,200 healed in 38s"). Type `/btf last` to see that fight spell by spell: hits, crits, total, share and biggest hit.
- **Your own rules for a spell**: hide a spell you don't want to see, or give it a color of its own (Spells tab).
- **Four text areas** you can drag anywhere on screen, each with its own movement (Scroll, Pop, Fountain or Horizontal), and your pick of which kinds of text go to which area.
- **Your look**: 23 fonts (plus any your other addons share through LibSharedMedia; on a Russian game, the ones with Russian letters), a separate font for crits if you like, an outline (thin or thick) or a drop shadow, text and crit size, a smallest crit (smaller ones show as normal hits), bigger text for bigger hits, short numbers (12.3k), scroll speed and distance, your own colors, and for each area its own size, opacity and direction (up or down, straight or curved), and left, centered or right text for the side areas.
- **Your choice of what's shown.** Turn any kind of text off, hide your auto attacks, icons and spell names per area, hide small hits and heals, and hide the game's own numbers so nothing shows twice. Put a line's parts in your own order, like `{icon} {damage} {name}`.
- **Sounds** if you want them, on your crits and killing blows: pick from 18 of the game's sounds (Crit, Impact, Anvil, Battle horn, Boss defeated, Cheers, Epic loot...), or any your other addons share through LibSharedMedia.
- **Masque**: if you use it, the spell icons on your text take your Masque skin (group "BattleText Forever" in Masque's options).
- **Low health and low mana warnings** if you want them: a big "Low health!" or "Low mana!" with a sound as you drop low, so you notice in time. You pick the sound, and how low your mana goes before it warns.
- **Settings per character** if you want them, starting from a copy of your shared ones, and **share your settings** with a friend as a line of text.

## Installation

1. Download the latest release.
2. Unzip it into your WoW: Forever `Interface\AddOns` folder so you end up with an `AddOns\BattleTextForever\` folder.
3. Restart the game, or type `/reload` if it's already running.

## Using it

- **Your hits show as soon as you log in**: on your target, and on the mobs attacking you or your pet.
- **BattleText starts by itself.** When you log in, it turns on the game's combat lines, which let it name the ticks of your bleeds and tell your hits from everyone else's (see Good to know). If a fight ends and no line came (a chat addon can get in the way), a **Start BattleText** button shows at the top of the screen and a line in chat says so (turn off **Remind me to click Start** in the options to stop that line). Click it once and you're set until you log out. You can bind a key to it, or put `/click BattleTextForeverStart` at the top of a macro you press anyway; once started, that does nothing. Right-click the button to hide it until you log in again.
- **Move the text.** Turn on **Move the text areas** in the options (or type `/btf unlock`) and drag the four boxes where you want them. For an exact spot, click a box and nudge it with the arrow keys (Shift moves 10 pixels). Closing the options locks them again.
- **See it without fighting.** Type `/btf test`, or right-click the minimap button.
- **Open the options.** Type `/btf`, or left-click the minimap button.

### Options window

The options have the same look as TauntMaster Forever, ToppedOff Forever and Outfitter Forever: tabs down the left and a switch for each setting. Point at a setting's name for what it does; a setting that does nothing with your other choices is greyed out.

| Tab | What's there |
|---|---|
| **General** | Show BattleText, move the text areas, hide the game's own numbers, minimap button, remind me to click Start, login message, settings for this character only, share settings (export and import). On every tab, beside Close: show sample text, reset positions, reset all |
| **Text** | Font (a list of 23, plus fonts other addons share through LibSharedMedia), crit font, outline and crit outline (none, thin, thick or shadow), text size, crit size, short numbers (12.3k), size by hit, icon zoom, smallest crit |
| **Motion** | Crits stay in place, add up rapid hits, time on screen, area height, how long ticks and area hits add up |
| **Outgoing** | Damage, misses, auto attacks, pet, damage shields, name seal hits, icons, names, hide hits below a number, DoTs and area spells, line order; Appearance: size, opacity, movement, alignment, scroll upward and curved scrolling |
| **Incoming** | Damage, avoids, "(blocked)" on partly blocked hits, power gains, icons, names, damage schools; Warnings: low health and low mana, each with its own sound, and the mana line; Appearance: size, opacity, movement, alignment, scroll upward and curved scrolling |
| **Healing** | Heals you get, heals you do, show overhealing, icons, names, show who you healed, hide heals below a number, line order; Appearance: size, opacity, movement and scroll upward |
| **Notifications** | Show: combat, killing blows, experience, reputation, honor, loot, money, skill ups, seals, buffs, ability alerts, combo points, dispels, fight summary, cooldowns ready, interrupts, icons, crit sound and kill sound (each with its own pick of sound). Appearance: size, opacity, movement and scroll upward |
| **Layout** | Which area each kind of text shows in: your hits, your misses, heals you do, damage you take, attacks you avoid, heals you get, power gains, notifications. Your hits and misses can also go over the enemy's nameplate, with left/right and up/down sliders |
| **Spells** | Type a spell's name to put it on your list, then hide it or give it its own color |
| **Colors** | The color of your hits, spells, misses, damage you take, avoids, power gains, heals, notifications, combat and killing blows, experience, loot, seals, buffs, ability alerts, combo points, dispels, low health and low mana; reset colors |

### Keybindings

Go to **Options → Keybindings → BattleText Forever**:

| Binding | Does |
|---|---|
| **Start BattleText** | Same as clicking the Start button |
| **Open options** | Opens or closes the options window |

### Slash commands

| Command | Does |
|---|---|
| `/btf` | Open or close the options |
| `/btf test` | Show sample text |
| `/btf lock` · `/btf unlock` | Lock or unlock the text areas |
| `/btf reset` | Put the text areas back where they started |
| `/btf resetall` | Put every setting back to how it started (asks first) |
| `/btf on` · `/btf off` | Turn the text on or off |
| `/btf debug` | Start or stop recording the combat lines the game sends (for bug reports; it turns itself off when you log in) |
| `/btf copy` | Show the recorded lines in a box you can copy from |
| `/btf report` | After playing a while with debug on: only the lines that look wrong, each kind counted with one example |
| `/btf last` | Your last fight, spell by spell |
| `/btf check` | Check the spells, texts and icons BattleText uses against your game, and report anything missing |
| `/btf gear` | Show what BattleText read from the gear you're wearing (then `/btf copy`) |
| `/btf export` · `/btf import` | Share your settings as a line of text, or take someone else's |

`/battletext` works too.

## Good to know

WoW: Forever doesn't let addons read the combat log. The game tells an addon **what happened to a unit** (it took 27 damage, it dodged), but not **who did it** or **with which spell**. BattleText works from that:

- **Your hits are read from the unit you hit**: your target, and the mobs attacking you or your pet. An area spell (Fire Nova, Arcane Explosion, Swipe...) also shows on every other mob it hits at the same moment. Turn on **enemy nameplates** to see your hits on the ones you aren't targeting.
- **Alone, until the game's combat lines are flowing, every hit on those units is shown as yours**, so another player hitting the same mob shows up too. The exception is a mob someone else tagged that isn't after you or your pet: its hits are theirs and aren't shown.
- **BattleText turns on the game's combat lines when you log in** (or, if that doesn't work, after you click Start BattleText). From then on the game tells BattleText *when* you did something, and only that many hits are shown, so other people's are left out, alone or in a group (now and then a number may still be someone else's hit that landed at the same moment as yours). Alone, on a mob your pet is fighting, every hit still shows: your pet's hits can't be told from anyone else's (they aren't marked). Keep the Combat Log's filter on **My actions** (the default).
- **Spell names and icons** show for:
  - hits that land the instant you cast (instant attacks and spells with no travel time);
  - spells that fly to their target and land a moment later: Fireball, Frostbolt, Frostfire Bolt, Pyroblast, Arcane Wrath, Shadow Bolt, Soul Fire, Wrath, Starfire, Lightning Bolt, Chain Lightning, Hammer of Wrath, Arcane Shot, Multi-Shot and Aimed Shot (and the burn Fireball, Frostfire Bolt and Pyroblast leave);
  - the ticks of your damage-over-time spells (Rake, Rip, Rend, Moonfire, Corruption, Shadow Word: Pain and the like). Bleeds need the combat lines;
  - channeled spells (Arcane Missiles, Mind Flay, Drain Life, Drain Soul, Wrack, Starshards, Blizzard, Rain of Fire, Hurricane, Volley, Hellfire, Tranquility, Penance) and spells that keep burning an area (Consecration, Flamestrike, Magma, Fire Nova and Searing Totems), on every mob they hit;
  - explosives you throw (Engineering's dynamite, bombs and grenades, Goblin Sapper Charge), on every mob they hit;
  - your ranged attacks: Auto Shot, Shoot (bow, gun, crossbow or wand) and Throw, as they land. Your swings get your main hand weapon's icon (or the Attack icon with nothing in your hands);
  - your gear's **"Chance on hit"** damage (Shadowfang, Thunderfury and the like) and weapon enchants that hurt (Fiery Weapon, Icy Chill, Lifestealing, Unholy Weapon), named after the item or enchant; and a rogue's poisons (Instant, Wound and Deadly Poison), with the poison's name and icon;
  - your **damage shields**: buffs (Thorns, Lightning Shield, Retribution Aura, Fire Shield), as soon as they hit, and gear that hurts whoever strikes you (named after the item). Turn off **Damage shields** in the options to hide these;
  - a paladin's **seal** (Righteousness, Command, Fury): its Holy damage landing with your swing. Turn off **Name seal hits** in the options to show it as a plain number.
  - a paladin's **Shield Specialization**: the mana a block gives back (shows with **Power gains** on).

  Other hits show as a plain number in their school's color.
- **Seals in a fight.** The game hides your buffs during a fight, so a seal coming off is worked out: a new seal replaces it, or its time runs out (Judgement leaves it on).
- **Buffs** (off unless you turn them on) show when they go on or come off. The game hides your buffs during a fight: there, a buff you put on yourself (Slice and Dice, Evasion, Sprint...) shows as you cast it, and the rest of what changed, including when those ran out, shows when the fight ends. Food, drink, and buffs with no time limit (mounts, auras, stances) aren't shown, and nothing is shown when you die.
- **The last swing on a mob may not show**: the game stops reporting a unit the moment it dies.
- **Damage you take has no spell names.** Its school still shows (the game doesn't hide it).
- **The fight summary counts what BattleText can read.** When the game hides a hit's number, it isn't in the total. Killing blows (and their sound) need the game to let BattleText read its combat lines.
- **Auto attacks off**: without the game's combat lines, a physical hit BattleText can't name counts as a swing and is hidden too.
- When the game does let BattleText read the Combat Log's lines, they're used instead: every hit then has its spell, and your pet's hits are marked.

## Troubleshooting

- **No numbers for your hits.** Target what you're hitting, or turn on enemy nameplates. In a group, click **Start BattleText** if it shows.
- **A bleed's ticks have no name.** Click **Start BattleText** if it shows.
- **Start BattleText does nothing.** A chat addon that replaces the game's chat window (like Chattynator) hides the game's Combat Log tab, which the button opens, and there's no real way around that. Your hits still show without it, but other people's hits on your target may show as yours, and bleed ticks have no name. Right-click the button to hide it. The button also goes away by itself if the combat lines start some other way.
- **Other people's hits show as mine.** Click **Start BattleText** if it shows, and keep the Combat Log's filter on **My actions**. Alone, a mob your pet is fighting still shows every hit on it.
- **Numbers show twice.** Turn on **Hide the game's own numbers** in the options.
- **Something isn't shown, or has the wrong name.** Type `/btf debug` and play as usual for a while (it keeps a whole session, until you log out or reload). Then type `/btf report` and copy it into a bug report: it lists only what looks wrong. `/btf copy` shows everything recorded. Type `/btf debug` again to stop.
- **A spell or icon looks wrong.** Type `/btf check`, then `/btf copy`, and add the report to a bug report.
- **Your gear's hits have no name** (a cloak or ring that hits back, a weapon's "Chance on hit", a poison), or the wrong one. Type `/btf gear` out of combat, then `/btf copy`, and add it to a bug report. This helps most when your game isn't in English.
- **The text is in the wrong place.** Type `/btf unlock` and drag the boxes, or `/btf reset`.

## Feedback and bug reports

Found a bug or have an idea? Please [submit it on GitHub](https://github.com/severd8/battletextforever/issues/new/choose). A short form asks for your class, your Combat Log filter and any error message. You'll need a free GitHub account. Otherwise, feel free to leave a comment on the CurseForge page.

## Translations

BattleText shows its options, chat messages and on-screen words in your game's language when a translation is in (spell and item names always are, since they come from the game). Anything not translated yet shows in English. Korean (thanks to Jaemok) and Simplified Chinese (thanks to Sanchez_3000) are in. To help with your language, fill in its file in the addon's `Locales` folder (`deDE.lua` German, `frFR.lua` French, `esES.lua`/`esMX.lua` Spanish, `itIT.lua` Italian, `ptBR.lua` Portuguese, `ruRU.lua` Russian, `koKR.lua` Korean, `zhCN.lua`/`zhTW.lua` Chinese). Each line is the English text, then yours after the `=`. Send it on CurseForge or GitHub.

## Support the addon

BattleText Forever is free. If you enjoy it, you can [leave a small tip on Ko-fi](https://ko-fi.com/tauntmasterforever). Thank you!

## All addons by me

- **TauntMaster Forever**: one-click taunts off your healers and DPS, for tanks.
- **ToppedOff Forever**: reminds you when buffs, food, reagents, ammo or gear need topping off.
- **Outfitter Forever**: save your gear as outfits and switch between them with one click, or let them change by themselves.
- **BattleText Forever**: scrolling combat text for your hits, heals and the damage you take.
- **AuctionHouse Forever**: a bigger Auction House window, so long item names stop getting cut off.
- **GatherPath Forever**: the shortest gathering route through your GatherMate2 herb and ore nodes, on the world map and minimap.
- **ARS Forever** (Azeroth Revenue Service): see how much gold a player has made and the most they've ever held, for you and anyone you inspect.

## License

MIT — see [LICENSE](https://github.com/severd8/battletextforever/blob/main/LICENSE).

The fonts in the `Fonts` folder are open fonts, unmodified, each under its own licence (in `Fonts/Licenses`): Anton, Archivo Black, Bangers, Barlow Condensed, Bebas Neue, Cinzel Decorative, Fira Sans, Lato, Metamorphous, New Rocker, Poppins, Press Start 2P, PT Sans Narrow, Rajdhani and Russo One (SIL Open Font License 1.1), Luckiest Guy and Permanent Marker (Apache License 2.0), and Ubuntu (Ubuntu Font Licence 1.0).

# Changelog

## 1.43.0

- **Left and Right alignment work the right way round.** Lines used to start from the middle of their window, so "Left" text sat in the right half of the box (and "Pop Left" popped on the right). Now Left lines up with the window's left edge and Right with its right edge. Your windows shift over once by half their width when you update, so your text stays exactly where it was on screen.
- **Move windows one pixel at a time.** While the text areas are unlocked, click a window to pick it (it gets a gold edge), then use the arrow keys to nudge it 1 pixel at a time, or 10 with Shift. Click it again to let go. Locking the windows or starting a fight lets go too, so your arrow keys are never stuck.
- **Sample text and the reset buttons are in the bottom bar.** "Show sample text", "Reset positions" and "Reset all" sit next to Close now, so you can test the look from any tab. Close looks different from them, since it only shuts the window.
- **No more small hitches when you loot.** Every looted item made BattleText re-read all your gear's tooltips. Now it only re-reads them when something you wear actually changes, like new gear or a new poison.
- **Consecration ticks keep their name with Retribution Aura on.** A Consecration tick that came without its combat line, often when the mob died, could show as a bare number. It's named Consecration now.
- **Hunters: your shots stop going to your pet** (GitHub #41). With your pet on the same mob, the pet's next blow after your shot often took the shot's name ("Auto Shot Dodge", "Aimed Shot Parry"), and then the real shot showed up as your pet's. Now only a hit that comes with your own combat line is named as your shot. If your pet and a hawk are both on the same mob, their hits still both show as your pet's, because the game doesn't say which one hit.
- **Wanding doesn't show your melee weapon** (GitHub #40). A wand miss or resist, or a swing the game counted along with your wand shot, could show your main hand weapon's icon. That doesn't happen anymore.

## 1.42.0

- **BattleText speaks German.** On a German game the options window, on-screen words, chat messages and the fight summary are now in German. (Thanks to ogogo1 for the whole translation.)
- **Longer words fit the options window.** Buttons now grow to fit their text, and the sound lists beside "Low health", "Low mana", "Crit sound" and "Kill sound" (and the color beside "Hide" on the Spells tab) move over when the label is longer, so German and other languages aren't cut off. The "Good to know" box grows with its text; if the General page runs out of room, the Share settings note moves into the Export and Import tooltips.
- Also in this version: Shield Specialization's mana (see 1.41.1 below).

## 1.41.1

- **Shield Specialization's mana shows now.** A Protection paladin's blocks give mana back, but on Forever the game sends no mana line for it at all, so it never showed. Now the block itself shows it: "+X Mana Shield Specialization", at most once every 3 seconds like the talent. If the game lets BattleText read your mana bar, X is what the bar actually went up (and nothing shows when your mana was full). If your mana is hidden, it shows 4% of your most mana, or "+4% Mana" when that's hidden too. Mana only shows with "Power gains" turned on (Incoming tab).

## 1.41.0

- **`/btf report`: send one report instead of many logs.** `/btf debug` now keeps a whole play session (it used to keep only the last fight or so). Play for a while, then type `/btf report`: it shows only the lines that look wrong, each kind counted with one example. That covers casts whose hit showed with no name, heals on you with no source, and hits that went unclaimed. Copy it into one bug report, and everything in it can be fixed together. `/btf copy` still shows everything. The recording ends when you log out or reload.

## 1.40.5

- **Ravage keeps its name and icon.** Opening from Prowl with Ravage could show its hit as a plain white hit with your auto attack icon. The game sends Ravage's hit just before the cast itself, and sometimes without the hidden line that used to tell them apart. Now when a cast has no hit after it, the hit right before it is the cast's.
- **Thrill of Adventure's first heal is caught sooner.** The first heal can come as early as one second after your killing blow, not two, so it's named from the first tick now.

## 1.40.4

- **Thrill of Adventure's heals are named.** After your killing blow, this talent heals you a little every 2 seconds, five times. Those heals used to show as a bare "+" with no name. Now they show as Thrill of Adventure with its icon. If you'd rather not see them, add "Thrill of Adventure" on the Spells tab and switch Hide on. (Turning off "Unnamed heals on you" no longer hides them, since they have a name now.)

## 1.40.3

- **Rake's bleed shows as Rake again.** On some games Rake's bleed ticks come without the hidden combat log line the addon used to recognise them, so after the first hit they showed up as plain white hits. Now a physical hit right on Rake's 3 second beat, up to its three ticks, is named Rake. On games that do send those lines, nothing changes.
- **The Spells tab row is tidier.** "Usual color" no longer runs under the Remove button.
- **Clearer `/btf debug`.** When a hit is hidden on the Spells tab, the log now says which spell it was, like "hidden on the Spells tab (Spiked Shell Band)". With Thorns and a Spiked Shell Band, each blow on you makes two Nature hits: Thorns' is shown, the ring's is hidden, and now the log says so.

## 1.40.2

- **Numbers over nameplates no longer pile on top of each other.** In a busy fight, a new number over a nameplate could land right on one still fading out, so "Claw 36" and "Dodge 58" turned into one blur. Now they line up in one column over the nameplate: the newest pops in at the bottom and pushes the others up, so every number stays readable. At most six show over one nameplate at a time; past that the oldest goes.

## 1.40.1

- **Glancing blows and seals in your game's language.** On a German (or other non-English) game, glancing blows said "(glancing)" and paladin seals kept their English names, like "+Seal of Command". Now glancing and crushing blows use the game's own word ("Streifschlag" in German), and seals show the name your game gives them ("Siegel des Befehls"), on the seal notice and on the seal's hits. (Thanks to ogogo1.)

## 1.40.0

- **Your hits over the enemy's nameplate.** On the Layout tab, "Your hits" (and "Your misses", if you like) can now be set to **Enemy nameplates**. Each number then pops up over the nameplate of the mob you hit and drifts up, instead of scrolling in the Outgoing area. A mob with no nameplate on screen still gets its numbers in Outgoing, so nothing is lost. Two new sliders under it, **Left and right** and **Up and down**, move the numbers to fit custom nameplates from other addons. Off unless you pick it. Turn on enemy nameplates in the game (V) to use it. (Thanks to xSky7 for the idea.)

## 1.39.0

- **Put your lines in your own order.** A new "Line order" box on the Outgoing tab sets how your hits and misses are written, with `{icon}`, `{name}` and `{damage}`. The usual is `{icon} {name} {damage}`; type `{icon} {damage} {name}` to get "[icon] 250 Fireball", or take a part out. The Healing tab has its own box for the heals you do. Reset puts it back. Works with hidden numbers too, and the Icons and Names switches still hide their parts. (Thanks to xSky7 for the idea.)

## 1.38.3

- **Masque icons are the right size again.** With Masque installed, the spell icons on your text came out much bigger than the text (and stayed big with BattleText's Masque group turned off). Masque sizes a skin once, when the icon is first set up, so it never shrank to your text size. Now the icons are scaled to your text size, skin and all. (Thanks to Oncewasperfect.)

## 1.38.2
